record.question: Make the statistical test to get the pvalue of the two groups of patients in terms of their progression-free survival. Save the results as `pvalue`.
record.answer:
{"reference_answer": "from lifelines.statistics import logrank_test
# Perform the log-rank test
results = logrank_test(amp_data['PFS_MONTHS'], wild_data['PFS_MONTHS'], 
                       event_observed_A=amp_data['PFS_STATUS'].apply(lambda x: 1 if x == '1:Yes' else 0), 
                       event_observed_B=wild_data['PFS_STATUS'].apply(lambda x: 1 if x == '1:Yes' else 0))
pvalue = results.p_value", "test_cases": "assert abs(pvalue-0.004661039915631175)< 1e-8"}
